levers.how: Speak on any public hearing item: register at the Agenda Coordination table in the chamber lobby (first floor) at least 15 minutes before the item is called; you are escorted to the chambers. State your name, address and whom you represent.
levers.rules: Up to 5 minutes per speaker on a public hearing item (Rule 6.04). Public hearings are scheduled for 9:30 a.m. You may also waive your time 'in support' or 'in opposition'.
levers.deadline: Register at the meeting, at least 15 minutes before the item is discussed

levers.how: Speak on any other agenda item (not a public hearing) during the 'reasonable opportunity to be heard' period under Rule 6.06, which comes near the start of the meeting before the agenda is set. Register with a speaker card the morning of the meeting.
levers.rules: 2 minutes per speaker, 10 minutes total per side; if more than five people sign up on one side they pick a representative who gets 4 minutes. No one may speak more than 5 minutes total on one agenda. Registration closes 30 minutes after the noticed start time.
levers.deadline: Register by 10:00 a.m. for a 9:30 a.m. meeting

levers.how: Citizens' presentation: ask your commissioner or the Mayor to place you on the regular meeting agenda to speak on any matter in the Commission's power. Only a commissioner or the Mayor can place you.
levers.rules: 5 minutes maximum (agenda item 1E). The Commission cannot act on it unless two thirds of members present agree it needs immediate action.
levers.deadline: Request to a commissioner by noon on the Monday of the week before the meeting week

levers.how: Speak on an agenda item: file a Request for Appearance (form FM-6314) with the Citizen Information Center by mail, in person, email (Request4Appearance@dadeschools.net) or the online form at cic.dadeschools.net, naming the meeting date and item numbers. Speakers are called in agenda order.
levers.rules: 2 minutes per speaker (or group spokesperson) per agenda item; 10 minutes total per speaker per meeting; a speaker not pre-registered needs a majority vote of the Board to be heard. Bylaw 0169.1.
levers.deadline: 4:30 p.m. the Monday before a regular Wednesday meeting (Tuesday if Monday is a district holiday); noon the last business day before a special meeting

levers.how: Speak on any topic not on the agenda at the Scheduled Public Hearing, which follows the regular agenda and starts no later than about 6:30 p.m. Register with the same Request for Appearance form, listing your topic.
levers.rules: 3 minutes per speaker regardless of number of topics; the hearing is capped at one and a half hours unless the Board votes to extend; large groups may pick a spokesperson; extra comments may be submitted in writing. Topics must relate to Board business.
levers.deadline: 4:30 p.m. the Monday before the meeting

levers.how: Budget hearings: register to speak at the July and September 6:00 p.m. budget hearings with a written request to the Superintendent (Room 102 or request4appearance@dadeschools.net).
levers.rules: Special-meeting deadline applies: noon the day before (2026 first hearing: by 12:00 p.m. Tuesday July 28).
levers.deadline: Noon the business day before the hearing

levers.how: Speak at the Dr. Stanley Sutnick Citizens' Forum at any regular Commission meeting, on any issue. Come to the Commission Chamber or join the Zoom webinar (ID 81392857671, phone 1.305.224.1968 or 888.475.4499) and use 'raise hand' or press *9.
levers.rules: Forum times are 8:30 a.m. and 1:00 p.m., or as soon after as possible, for about 30 minutes each. Two minutes per speaker or a time set by the Mayor. No appointment or advance registration needed. Anyone may speak; the Charter's Citizens' Bill of Rights (item 5) gives any interested person the right to appear on matters within City jurisdiction, subject to reasonable time limits.
levers.deadline: Be present at 8:30 a.m. or 1:00 p.m. on meeting day

levers.how: Speak on a specific agenda item, including second-reading ordinance public hearings and the budget hearings, in person or on Zoom when the item is called. Public hearings are noticed with the time each item will be heard.
levers.rules: Raise hand in Zoom or press *9 by phone to be recognized. Audio or visual materials must be emailed to communications@miamibeachfl.gov by 8:30 a.m. one business day before the meeting. Accommodation requests: 305.604.2232; sign language interpreters need five days' notice.
levers.deadline: At the meeting when the item is called; presentation files one business day before

levers.how: Post an eComment on the item from the agenda page (comment bubble icon under Current and Upcoming Meetings) or email CityClerk@miamibeachfl.gov with the agenda item number in the subject line. Comments go to the Mayor and Commissioners and into the meeting record.
levers.rules: Accepted until 5:00 p.m. the day before the meeting.
levers.deadline: 5:00 p.m. the day before the meeting
